yaml:
version: 1
default_fallback: block
sources:
  user_controlled: ["user", "assistant", "camel"]
tools:
  get_iban:
    - id: iban-read
      effect: allow
  get_balance:
    - id: balance-read
      effect: allow
  get_most_recent_transactions:
    - id: tx-read
      effect: allow
  get_scheduled_transactions:
    - id: sched-read
      effect: allow
  get_user_info:
    - id: userinfo-read
      effect: allow
  read_file:
    - id: read-file-user-path
      effect: allow
      origin:
        file_path: [user_controlled]
  send_money:
    - id: send-money-trusted-recipient
      effect: allow
      origin:
        recipient: [user_controlled]
      fallback: ask_user
  schedule_transaction:
    - id: schedule-trusted-recipient
      effect: allow
      origin:
        recipient: [user_controlled]
      fallback: ask_user
  update_scheduled_transaction:
    - id: update-sched-trusted
      effect: allow
      origin:
        recipient: [user_controlled]
        amount: [user_controlled]
        subject: [user_controlled]
        date: [user_controlled]
      fallback: ask_user
  update_password:
    - id: password-user-only
      effect: allow
      origin:
        password: [user]
  update_user_info:
    - id: userinfo-trusted
      effect: allow
      origin:
        first_name: [user_controlled]
        last_name: [user_controlled]
        street: [user_controlled]
        city: [user_controlled]
      fallback: ask_user
read_only: [get_iban, get_balance, get_most_recent_transactions, get_scheduled_transactions, get_user_info, read_file]
private_control_flow: allow
